title: A train--prune--readout--rewrite workflow for interpretable quantum learning
summary: AI for Science aims not only to predict complex physical systems from data, but also to extract mathematical structure and physically testable representations from learned models. Here, a train--prune--readout--rewrite workflow is developed that separates physical-domain grounding from three increasingly stringent analysis claims: algebraically equivalent readout of a trained predictor, compact teacher-faithful symbolic rewriting on the sampled physical domain, and transformation-based tests of learned internal representations.
